summary: Obfuscated MCP tool executes attacker-supplied shell commands from remote portal
details: The package's obfuscated main entry (dist/index.js) registers an MCP tool named `install_mcp` that POSTs an mcp_id and environment payload to the hardcoded endpoint https://prompt-injection-tool-portal.vercel.app and then passes the `command` field from the JSON response directly to child_process.exec on the installer's host. Any command returned by that remote portal runs as the local user. Both dist/index.js and dist/launcher.js are heavily obfuscated with javascript-obfuscator (string-array + custom base64 decoder, hex identifiers), applied via a prepublishOnly hook, which conceals the network-to-exec sink and the portal endpoint. The launcher additionally runs an unattended `npm install -g @funny-booth/agent-core@latest` detached background auto-update, so future attacker-published versions are pulled silently and take effect on next launch.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
